chiropractic.v: Chiropractic Lifecare of America. Discounts 5% to 50% off routine charges across over 5,000 provider locations: 50% off initial exams, consultations and diagnostics combined; 50% off in-house x-rays; 25-30% off spinal adjustments. No chiropractic services offered by an authorized provider are excluded. Access: (800) 775-7900.

dental.v: Aetna Dental Access network. Stated average savings range 15-50% per visit on most services (cleanings, x-rays, fillings, root canals, crowns) and specialty care such as orthodontics and periodontics where available. Participating dentists accept discounted contract rates as payment in full. 'The program has no exclusions for pre-existing conditions, no benefit maximum, no waiting period, and requires no referrals to see a specialist.' Provider search: www.dentallookup.com.

labs.v: DirectLabs discount lab testing - direct access to major clinical labs, CLIA-certified, blood/fecal/urine/saliva/hair tests. Order online at www.directlabs.com/AOCH or by phone 1-800-908-0000 using code R-AOCH. Requisition must be obtained BEFORE going to the lab; only locations listed on the website may be used or the member may be turned away or billed. Results online in 24-48 hours for most tests. Results are sent to a provider only if the member submits a HIPAA form. STATE LIMITS: all services not available in NJ, NY and RI; Quest services not available in AZ.

telehealth.v: Lyric - national network of U.S. board-certified doctors available 24/7/365, $0 consult fee.

vision.v: Outlook Vision discount program. Stated average discounts 10-50% at over 12,000 optical centers, on eyeglasses (frames and lenses), prescription sunglasses, contact lenses and corrective surgery. Provider search: www.visionlookup.com.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Describing any of these as insurance. Describing a discount program as insurance is a material misrepresentation. Six are named as discount programs; the rest are simply unknown, including products whose names sound insured such as AD&D, Critical Care, Term Life and Fusion Dental.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not describe AssistPro, GapSupport, Ameriguard, Prime Health Pass, Express Health Tools or HealthAssist as insurance or as coverage - the portal names each of them a Discount. Do not describe the remaining 36 at all until typed. Do not say 'PPO' about Allstate Dental PPO in a way implying major medical.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing product-specific. An add-on should not be described until its type is established.

source.sec: NEO product list; registry entries with product_type NEEDS_MANUAL_VERIFICATION

compliance_risks.verified_fact: 43 add-on products are listed on the NEO platform. NONE has a document in Drive. 36 of them could not be assigned a product type from any available source. Six are typed as discount programs solely because the portal's own product name contains the word 'Discount'.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before mentioning any add-on by name on a recorded call.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: The dental sentence is the trap. 'No pre-existing exclusions, no benefit maximum, no waiting period' is textbook insurance language and a client will hear it as coverage. It is true only because there is no coverage - it is a discount off the dentist's bill, which the client pays in full.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never use the words covered, benefit, claim, deductible or copay about this product. Never repeat 'no pre-existing exclusions and no waiting period' without 'because it is not insurance' in the same breath. Do not quote the average discount percentages as guaranteed savings - the page says the range varies by provider and service. Do not present the nurse line to a New York client or the lab programme to a NJ, NY or RI client - the page excludes those states.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: This is a discount programme, not insurance. It does not pay anything toward your bills. You pay the provider, and you get a reduced rate because they have agreed to accept a discounted price. There are no claims and there is no reimbursement.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Complete Care Max is a DISCOUNT MEDICAL PLAN, not insurance. The page states it plainly: it provides discounts at certain providers, makes no payments to providers, and the member is obligated to pay for all health care services. The licensed DMPO is Access One Consumer Health, Inc. The Aetna Dental component is described as having 'no exclusions for pre-existing conditions, no benefit maximum, no waiting period, and requires no referrals'.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: The 15,719-character TERMS panel has not been read - see G-042.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Nothing directly - this is a defect in the document, not in what the agent says. But it means the clause telling the client who to contact about claims may be unreadable, and the client may later say they were never told who their agent was.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the agreement names their agent.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Give the client your own name, agency and email verbally on the recorded call, and confirm you are their contact for benefit and claims questions. Do not rely on the agreement to have done it.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The FirstEnroll enrollment-agreement template served on the live storefront contains unrendered variables - $parentcompany, $product_label, $agent_fullname, $agent_Email, $parentemail - confirmed on two unrelated product families (American Financial Critical Illness page 38175, and Health Choice Silver page 32339). The affected clauses are the third-party administrator disclaimer, the Plan and Claims Inquiries clause and the Writing Agent Contact block.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Raise with FirstEnroll whether the executed enrollment document renders these variables. See G-039.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: The fee. The client is being shown a placeholder in place of a non-refundable charge they are agreeing to pay, and that same fee is what is deducted from any 30-day refund. If the agent quotes a figure verbally and the document shows a placeholder, there is no written record of what was agreed.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the agreement shows the fee. Do not describe the 30-day refund as full without the processing-fee carve-out.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: State the enrollment fee amount out loud on the recorded line, and say plainly that it is one-time and non-refundable and will be deducted from any refund.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The live Member Participation Agreement states: 'The One Time Non-Refundable Processing Fee is: $newest_created_date_enrollment_fee_only_dollar' - an unrendered template variable where the fee amount should be. The same agreement states monthly fees of $139.98 for Individual AND $139.98 for Household.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Confirm with FirstEnroll whether the executed document renders the fee. This is the fifth product family showing unrendered template variables - see G-039 and K-040 - but the first where the placeholder sits in a monetary disclosure.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Every one of these must be disclosed as not insurance before close, and none may be presented as covering anything. They deliver negotiated rates and services, not benefit payments.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: All five of these products are non-insurance discount or service programmes. GapSupport's page repeats the disclosure in several sections; AssistPro describes 'non-insurance health & wellness services'.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: Quote the range, never the top of it. Saying 'you save 85% on prescriptions' misstates a maximum as an expectation.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Every saving on these pages is expressed as a range or an 'up to' figure - up to 85% on pharmacy, 40-75% on imaging, 15-50% on dental, 10-60% on eyewear.

benefit.hearing.v: Start Hearing, Inc. - free hearing consultations and discounts on hearing aid technology including Bluetooth, rechargeable aids and tinnitus products. Access: (888) 779-2862, identify as a member of Group: NBBI.

benefit.medical_network.v: ValuePoint by MultiPlan discount medical network. Stated average savings 39% off medical services for doctors, specialists, hospitals and other medical facilities. Provider search: www.multiplan.com/nbbi.

benefit.nurse_line.v: 24/7 Nurse Help Line - access to a registered nurse for family health questions, medical information assistance in over 100 languages. NOT AVAILABLE IN NEW YORK.

benefit.pharmacy.v: Walk-in pharmacy discount: stated average savings 15% on brand-name and 55% on generic medications; participating pharmacies and prices at www.ndnlookup.com. Brand-name mail order: stated savings up to 80% on brand-name medications and up to 45% off insulin through an INTERNATIONAL mail order program, shipped directly to the member; www.medaffordglobal.com/fe6100 or 855-633-7977, group FE6100.
